description: Catalog page loads with search bar, all filter dropdowns, product cards, tabs, and scroll
preconditions: Seller is logged in with valid credentials
checkpoints: Verify all 4 primary filters (Super Category, Brand, SKU Status, Sort)
Verify All Products and Requested tabs toggle
expected_result: Catalog page loads completely with all UI elements and scroll works

description: Search bar filters products in real-time by keyword
preconditions: Seller is on Catalog page with products
checkpoints: Scroll to verify filtered results persist
expected_result: Search filters products immediately as user types

description: Super Category dropdown opens, has search, and filters products
checkpoints: Type category name and verify options appear
Select an option and verify products filter
expected_result: Super Category dropdown filters products correctly

description: Brand, SKU Status, and Sort dropdowns all open and filter correctly
checkpoints: Open Brand dropdown, verify search, select brand, verify filter
Open SKU Status filter, verify all status options, select one
Open Sort dropdown, verify sort options, select one
expected_result: All three dropdowns open with options and filter/sort products

description: More section reveals Category and Packing Size dropdowns with search and filter
checkpoints: Click More button, verify Category and Packing dropdowns appear
Open Category dropdown, verify search, select option, verify filter
Open Packing Size dropdown, verify search, select option, verify filter
expected_result: More section reveals Category and Packing filters that work correctly

description: All 5 product card types render correctly with expected elements
preconditions: Seller is on Catalog page with varied product states
checkpoints: Verify Addable (+) card type opens Add Product modal
Verify Manage Listing card opens Edit Product modal
Verify Incomplete card opens Request Product modal with fields
Verify Requested badge visible on products
Verify Blocked/OOS cards show status text
expected_result: All card types render with correct buttons/badges and open correct modals

description: Request Product flow: open modal, fill all fields, submit successfully
preconditions: Seller is on Catalog page with incomplete products
checkpoints: Verify all required fields present (Master Pack, Dead Weight, L/B/H, HSN, Image, MRP, Price, Expiry, In Stock)
expected_result: Request Product modal submits successfully with all fields filled

description: Incorrect Product flow: open modal, select issue, add comment, submit
checkpoints: Verify modal fields (issue dropdown, comment textarea, submit button)
Select issue type, add comment, submit
expected_result: Incorrect Product modal submits successfully with issue type and comment

description: Request Variant flow: open modal, verify pre-filled fields from parent product
checkpoints: Verify modal opens with form fields
Verify fields are pre-filled from parent product
expected_result: Request Variant modal opens with pre-filled fields inherited from parent product

description: Create New Product flow: scroll to section, open modal, verify all fields
checkpoints: Scroll to find 'Could not find your product?' section
Verify all fields present (Brand, Product Name, Packing, HSN, MRP, Your Price)
expected_result: Create New Product modal opens with all required fields
